test_title: PYST 4 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Each item describes a situation and is followed by four possible responses. Indicate the response you find most appropriate. Choose only one response for each item. The responses will be evaluated based on the level of appropriateness for the given situation.

Situation: A student has only 3 days left before an exam. She hasn't completed half the syllabus. What's the best strategy?

options.text: Watch motivational videos to calm nerves
Sleep less and cover all topics
Focus on high-weightage and familiar topics
Give up and skip the exam

solution:
Situation:

A student has only 3 days left before an exam and half the syllabus is still incomplete.

Analysis of Options:

Watch motivational videos to calm nerves

This may reduce stress, but it does not directly help in completing the syllabus. Hence, it is not the most practical strategy.
